entries.3fa3baf3095a3319: Businesses entrusted with the storage of agricultural products
entries.500f31c7100b5e9c: The company manufactures wheat flour, rye flour and bran (a by-product), and sells them directly or through wholesalers such as Kanen Co., Ltd. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥11,632 million, the largest of the segments.
entries.7e5df8afcdda04e8: The company and Ishibashi Kogyo Co., Ltd. conduct storage operations for agricultural products. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥56 million.
entries.8b4d2174685cd193: Consolidated subsidiaries Ishibashi Kogyo Co., Ltd. and Nakajima Seibaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell feed, and Kanen Co., Ltd. purchases and sells feed products. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,314 million.
entries.a1cd8fd670f52aab: Consolidated subsidiaries Torigoe Seibaku Co., Ltd., Ishibashi Kogyo Co., Ltd. and Nakajima Seibaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufacture round barley, pressed barley, mochi barley and barley bran (a by-product), and also purchase staple food products. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,400 million.
entries.a547d9bb55232af9: The company manufactures household and commercial premixes, the Innovate series (quality improvers and shelf-life extenders) and other processed foods, and also purchases dried noodles and other products under a business alliance with CSM (Ulma Schpatz). Consolidated subsidiaries Ota Bakery Co., Ltd. and Kurume Seimen Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell bread and confectionery, and fresh noodles, respectively. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,845 million.
entries.ec44a04f2697263f: A flour milling company based in Fukuoka Prefecture, manufacturing and selling wheat flour, premixes, pearled barley and other products.
